headline: As of 2026-11-06: 73,835,482 early/mail ballots cast nationally across 48 of 50 states, D+8.6 cast-ballot lean.
bullets: 73,835,482 early/mail ballots cast so far across 48 states reporting.
Across party-registration states, ballots cast lean D+8.6 by registration.
Most ballots cast: California (10,311,597), Florida (8,331,939), Texas (8,173,913).
